features.title: Move and inspect the model
features.description: Drag to orbit. Pinch to zoom or use the zoom buttons. Pan with two fingers (Shift-drag on desktop). Tap a layer to identify its material.

features.title: Choose a technology
features.description: Explore FinFET, nanosheet, forksheet and CFET. Changing Device, Inverter or Layout keeps the selected technology.

features.title: Preset views
features.description: Choose Isometric, Along channel or Across channel. The last view reveals the architecture’s distinctive gate or tier structure.

features.title: Section planes
features.description: Move a section slider to cut into the model. Solid cut faces reveal the films inside. The model stays visible above and through the controls.

features.title: Exploded view
features.description: Move Separate layers to spread the films apart. Return it to zero to reassemble the device.

features.title: Layer visibility
features.description: Show or hide individual layers, organized by process group. Tap a visible layer in the model to identify it.

features.title: Dimension callouts
features.description: Turn dimension callouts on or off to balance measurement detail and a clear view. Model coordinates are in nanometres.

features.title: See through the gate fill
features.description: Ghost the Mo gate fill to reveal the channel and surrounding films without hiding the entire gate.

features.title: Device specifications
features.description: Read the scene’s dimensions and design notes. These are representative teaching values, not a foundry process specification.

features.title: Parasitic capacitance
features.description: Select a capacitance row to highlight the two conductors and the material between them. Values are first-order estimates from this geometry.

features.title: CMOS inverter logic
features.description: Tap IN 0 or 1. The conducting transistor lights up and OUT takes the opposite value. This is a teaching visualization of inverter logic.

features.title: Cell layout and routing
features.description: Trace contacts, gate, vias and Metal 0. Try Top view to inspect routing; use IN to see the inverter’s logic state.

features.title: Compare architectures
features.description: See all four architectures at the same scale. Switch between Device, Inverter and Layout to compare device footprint with complete cell width.

features.title: Monolithic and sequential CFET
features.description: Compare the two CFET integration routes using the Monolithic and Sequential selector, then inspect the Tier interface view.

features.title: Why this device exists
features.description: Read what each architecture replaced, what stopped scaling and what the new structure costs. Close the reading panel to return to the same model.

features.title: Display and reset
features.description: Choose edge outlines, surface texture, slow rotation and a light background. Reset the scene to restore its default view.
